case_title: EDWARDS, VIDA MS. VS FOOD MAKER/PACK IN THE BOX

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY EDWARDS, VIDA MS. AS TO DEFENDANT FOOD MAKER/PACK IN THE BOX ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-15-1997 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT C
INVALID POS ON FOOD MAKER. COPY OF POS SUBMITTED.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF EDWARDS, VIDA MS. IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT FOOD MAKER/PACK IN THE BOX PROOF OF SERVICE WAIVED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
